'''Jashco Phurus''' was a [[human]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[pirate]] who prowled the [[Arrowhead Region]] of [[the galaxy]] east of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> Phurus was standing next to the wall opposite the entrance to Maz Kanata's castle on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]] when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Shortly after their entrance, many of the castle's patrons, Phurus included, rushed outside to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]], after which First Order forces [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed Kanata's castle.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> After the First Order attack, Phurus joined the [[Resistance]] alongside another [[Unidentified smuggler (Modrol)|smuggler]] after [[Maz Kanata]] introduced them to [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="CYD Maz Kanata" />

While at the castle, Phurus wore [[Color|red]] [[Tricorraan raider robes]] and carried a field-accelerated [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> He<ref name="Databank" /> had dark skin and shaved black [[hair]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jashco Phurus first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]<ref name="TFA" /> which was released on [[December 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref> The character was identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> and released in conjunction with film's release.<ref name="New Books" />
